_comment: THE MOD'S FIRST SOUNDS (#376, spec docs/scrap_hauler_spec.md section 9). Four events, the
spec's core set. The audio is SOURCED rather than generated (owner, 2026-09-05), and until
sourced files land each event REDIRECTS to a vanilla EVENT (type: event) so it resolves and
every hook in the code is exercised. A bare file path into the minecraft namespace does not
resolve from a mod's sounds.json - the SoundEngine logged 'Missing sound for event' for all
four - and an event redirect does. Swapping in the real audio is a change to this file and
nothing in Java: put the .ogg under assets/recompile/sounds/entity/scrap_hauler/ and replace
